questions.title: Multiplication Table
questions.description: Write a Java program that prints the multiplication table of 7 from 1 to 10 using a for loop.
constraints: Print each multiplication on a new line

questions.title: Sum of Even Numbers
questions.description: Write a Java program that calculates the sum of all even numbers from 1 to 20 using a while loop.
constraints: Only add even numbers to sum

examples.output: Sum of even numbers from 1 to 20: 110

questions.expectedOutput: Sum of even numbers from 1 to 20: 110

questions.title: Number Pyramid
questions.description: Write a Java program that prints a number pyramid with 5 rows. Each row should print the row number that many times (row 1 prints '1', row 2 prints '2 2', row 3 prints '3 3 3', etc.).
hints: Inner loop prints the number i times

questions.title: Prime Number Checker
questions.description: Write a Java program that checks if the number 29 is prime. Use a loop with break statement to optimize the check. A prime number is only divisible by 1 and itself.
constraints: Use a loop to check divisibility
Print whether number is prime or not
hints: If any divisor found, break and mark as not prime
Use boolean flag to track result

questions.title: Factorial Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that calculates the factorial of 6 (6!). Use a for loop. Remember: factorial of n = n * (n-1) * (n-2) * ... * 1. Display the calculation process.
hints: Multiply result by i in each iteration
Loop from n down to 1 or 1 up to n
